Count only the non-'Payment' transactions per invoice number, for invoices having at least one; top 10 by that count.
Filter rows to transaction_type != 'Payment' first, then group by invoice number and count the remaining rows; top 10 by count.

Treat NULL transaction_type as not 'Payment'. (The column is NOT NULL, so this can't arise.)

FROM Financial_Transactions
WHERE invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_type <> 'Payment')
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10
